sato.blurb: Writes the production code that makes Tara's tests pass. The builder.
sato.alt: Sato, the team's engineer, a broad smith resting a green-glowing hammer on his shoulder

tara.blurb: Writes the failing test first. Holds a veto on test coverage.
tara.alt: Tara, the test lead, a ranger drawing a bow with a crimson-tipped arrow

vik.blurb: Reads for simplicity and maintainability. Names problems; never fixes them.
vik.alt: Vik, the veteran reviewer, leaning on a tall sword-staff and holding up a loupe

pierrot.epithet: finds it before the attacker does
pierrot.blurb: Reads for what the change stopped doing. Holds a hard veto on security grounds.
pierrot.alt: Pierrot, the security tester, a hooded rogue in a white half-mask holding a dagger

archie.blurb: Designs the system and writes the record before a line of code is written.
archie.alt: Archie, the team's architect, holding a rolled cyan blueprint across his body

wei.blurb: Breaks consensus on purpose and builds the rationale afterwards.
wei.alt: Wei, the devil's advocate, leaning back mid-toss of a glowing magenta card

cam.epithet: asks what you will decide differently
cam.blurb: Probes your vague idea with one question at a time until the vision is concrete.
cam.alt: Cam, the team's guide, a hooded traveler holding out a glowing amber lantern

grace.blurb: Runs the board, tracks velocity, and keeps the party moving.
grace.alt: Grace, the sprint marshal, raising a tall violet banner

pat.epithet: says no as a full sentence
pat.blurb: Owns the backlog and prioritises ruthlessly. Speaks for you in proxy mode.
pat.alt: Pat, the product lead, holding out a set of burgundy priority scales

ines.blurb: Owns everything between git push and production traffic.
ines.alt: Ines, the SRE, throwing a yellow-knobbed deploy lever with goggles on her brow

dani.blurb: Design exploration, user flows, and accessibility review.
dani.alt: Dani, the designer, holding up a coral-edged interface panel and a brush

debra.blurb: Turns telemetry into decisions. The only one with notebook access.
debra.alt: Debra, the data scientist, in a pointed astronomer's hat holding a teal constellation

diego.epithet: writes for the reader, not the author
diego.blurb: Docs, changelogs, onboarding. If it isn't documented, it doesn't exist.
diego.alt: Diego, the technical writer, holding open a book with glowing teal script

prof.blurb: Explains the team's choices, Socratically. Assumes you're competent.
prof.alt: Prof, the mentor, in tweed gesturing with a pointer at a floating ochre diagram

cloud.epithet: prices the arrow on the diagram
cloud.blurb: Architects and tunes any cloud for cost and reliability.
cloud.alt: Cloud, the cloud specialist, a sky-mage with an azure cloud floating over his staff

review-party.blurb: Not one hero, a formation. Four lenses on one diff, and they are allowed to disagree.
review-party.alt: The Review Party: a warden, ranger, nightblade, and architect examining a glowing codex on a shared indigo stage

coder.blurb: An unnamed smith on the line.

tester.blurb: An unnamed archer on the line.

reviewer.blurb: An unnamed reviewer holding one lens.
